captions: Hello, and welcome to Camday English, Stage 2. In this lesson: My classroom.
Name classroom things and use ‘a’ and ‘an’.
Here are some new words. Pencil. You write and draw with it. Ruler.
You draw straight lines with it. Rubber. It takes away pencil marks.
Listen and say them. pencil
ruler
rubber.
And some more words. Bag. You carry your books in it. Book. It has pages to read.
Desk. A table where you work at school. Listen and say them. bag
book
desk.
Time for a question. The video will stop. Which word means: you write and draw with it?
Now some grammar: a and an. Use ‘an’ before a, e, i, o, u sounds.
Use ‘a’ before other sounds. For example: a pencil For example: an eraser
Now listen, and read along. My bag. Look in my school bag!
I have got a red pencil and a blue pencil. I have got a ruler and a rubber.
I have got a book about animals. I have got an apple for lunch. Yum!
Another question. The video will stop. What colour are the pencils?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like pencil, ruler, rubber.
You practised a and an. And you read My bag. Now try the practice questions.
See you next time!

q.prompt: Which word means “the person who helps you learn”?

options.fb: “lunch” means the meal in the middle of the day.

q.prompt: When does Ana go to school?

captions: Hello, and welcome to Camday English, Stage 2. In this lesson: My school day.
Use numbers and ‘I have got / I haven't got’.
Here are some new words. Teacher. The person who helps you learn. Friend.
A person you like to play with. Lunch. The meal in the middle of the day.
Listen and say them. teacher
friend
lunch.
And some more words. Playground. A place outside to play at school. Read.
Look at words and understand them. Write. Put words on paper. Listen and say them.
playground
read
write.
Time for a question. The video will stop.
Which word means: the person who helps you learn?
Now some grammar: have got and haven't got. Say ‘I have got’ for things you own.
Say ‘I haven't got’ for things you do not own. For example: I have got a sister.
For example: I haven't got a dog.
Now listen, and read along. Ana's school day. Ana goes to school at eight o'clock.
First, she reads a book with her teacher. Then she writes her name and the date.
At twelve o'clock she has lunch with her friend Omar.
After lunch they play in the playground. Ana loves school!
Another question. The video will stop. When does Ana go to school?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like teacher, friend, lunch.
You practised have got and haven't got. And you read Ana's school day.
Now try the practice questions. See you next time!
